text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the NHK Mile Cup. It's a classic-year G1 that Agnes Digital ran in last year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O! Doto! Trainer! Hi, everyone! I have someone I'd like to show you today!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What passion! Don't tell me, you're introducing us to your fiancé?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Bwah! What?! No! It's nothing like that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Anyway… Shall we head to Tokyo Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The four of us head out to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When the race begins, we see Agnes Digital rooting for…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here comes number four, today's favorite! Look at her go! She's holding down a strong lead, and…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's won it! A staggering shock from overseas! I say that the significance of this win makes her a clear contender to be the face of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoooa… Ooohhh…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A brilliant show and breakout performance by this new star. She's lacking in neither wits nor charisma.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She's so… strong! I can't believe how amazing that was!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I knew it! I knew it! I kneeew she was the one! WoAooGfSjgLl!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yup, yup, yup. I called it from the beginning! She's been popular with the other Uma simps lately too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With those looong strides and how she kills it on every type of track, it's no wonder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Not to mention those adorable eyes and long, slender legs! I just… I just…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! You're quite smitten with her, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Absolutely. I mean, she is not like everyone else! Ohhh, and to think she just came and won the very same race I ran in before… Swoon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! It's like my motherly instincts have just awoken! Do you guys mind if I go shout out some of this affection?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital makes a break for the fence by the track.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: NUMBER FOOOUR! YOU CAN DO IT! YOU HAVE A LONG ROAD AHEAD OF YOU, BUT I KNOW YOU CAN DO IT! I JUST KNOW IT!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: IF EVER YOU FEEL LOST OR IF THINGS GET HARD, US SENIORS ARE HERE FOR YOU!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She yells her heartfelt message at the top of her lungs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, she herself has been through quite a lot since last year's NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She learned about true intensity during T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto's first face-off at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her perspective changed significantly after she learned about King Halo's first-rate determination in the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now today, with the birth of a new generation of runners, the trail of Umamusume continues on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Amaaashing… So preshhhush… I can't believe I'm actually allowed inside this ring of feels…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhgggh! Hwaaah! It's like my insides have turned to mush…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! You're possessed by euphoria! But is it really okay for you to be so at ease?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If you cannot defeat me and Doto, how can you inspire the next generation?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Or, forget about inspiring them, they may overcome you entirely if you aren't careful. The Twinkle Series is a stage in which the strongest actors take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes… I'm well aware, thank you! And that's exactly why I want to run better.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I want to outpace both you and Doto for the sake of my classic-year cutie. And then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After I beat the two of you, I want to welcome her with a challenge!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: After beating—eek! …Y-y-you're really driven…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That just means I'll—we'll—have to try harder too. I'm looking forward to this fall.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's right! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The chaser is now the chased. With this extended cast of actors, the Twinkle Series has become an even more colorful spectacle.
